video:video.video:title: Identity Atlas explainer — Trust starts with clarity
video:video.video:description: A one-minute introduction to Identity Atlas: one shared view of who has access to what across Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Omada, midPoint and other systems. Open source, self-hosted, read-only.

video:video.video:title: Identity Atlas for Entra ID Governance — design access packages on facts, not guesswork
video:video.video:description: For Entra ID admins designing access packages: see which access a package already governs and which access was handed out by hand, share the matrix to agree on the design, and go from zero to insight in five steps. Free, open source, self-hosted.
